description: This script is a shell script that manages patch application, patching specific revisions of dependencies, and orchestrating build and testing steps for a CMake-based project. It includes functions for applying patches idempotently, ensuring specific revisions of repositories, and running build/test workflows.

methods.name: apply_patch_idempotent
methods.description: Apply a patch file to a target directory in an idempotent, non-interactive manner, avoiding conflicts and .rej files.

methods.name: ensure_thundertools_expected_revision
methods.description: Reset the ThunderTools repository to a specific expected revision/tag to ensure patch consistency.

methods.name: run_build_and_l1_tests
methods.description: Configure, build, and run L1 tests using CMake and CTest.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main workflow that orchestrates patching, revision pinning, building, and testing.
